question: How was the dataset collected?

answer.free_form_answer: from 3rd to 9th grade science questions collected from 12 US states
evidence: Questions: We make use of the 7,787 science exam questions of the Aristo Reasoning Challenge (ARC) corpus BIBREF31 , which contains standardized 3rd to 9th grade science questions from 12 US states from the past decade. title: Multi-class Hierarchical Question Classification for Multiple Choice Science Exams
answer_short: 7,787 science exam questions paired with detailed classification labels from a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy of 406 problem domains
answer_rationale: The dataset was collected by pairing 7,787 science exam questions with detailed classification labels derived from a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy of 406 problem domains, as stated in the abstract of the retrieved document.
